variants.name: Draft
variants.summary: Takes parts, links, a border and commits.

variants.name: Retired
variants.summary: Takes no edit and no commit; its revisions stay.

variants.name: Applied
variants.summary: Every rule applied; committed as one revision unless a dry run.

variants.name: Refused
variants.summary: One rule or the check refused; nothing changed.

variants.name: Requested
variants.summary: Submitted; the applier has not reported.

variants.name: Cancelled
variants.summary: Stopped before it ended, by a principal or by the runner.

variants.name: Done
variants.summary: Reached the end of what it was asked.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: Could not go on.

variants.name: Queued
variants.summary: Taken by its installation, not started.

variants.name: Running
variants.summary: Doing its work.

variants.name: Waiting
variants.summary: Waiting on a decision, an answer, a resource or a request.

variants.name: Bundled
variants.summary: Its bundle is written and handed to a translator.

variants.name: Degraded
variants.summary: A unit runs below its desired replicas or keeps failing.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: Its target gave up on it.

variants.name: Realizing
variants.summary: Its target starts its units.

variants.name: Refused
variants.summary: Its translator or its target refused it; nothing runs.

variants.name: Requested
variants.summary: Admitted; its bundle is being written.

variants.name: Running
variants.summary: Every unit runs as desired.

variants.name: Stopped
variants.summary: Taken down by its deployer.

variants.name: Translated
variants.summary: Its target's architecture is written, every object covered.

variants.name: Declared
variants.summary: Named by the bundle.

variants.name: Mapped
variants.summary: Mapped to an object of the target's architecture.

variants.name: Active
variants.summary: Takes new runs.

variants.name: Drained
variants.summary: Draining ended with no run left that has not ended.

variants.name: Draining
variants.summary: Takes no new run; the runs it holds go on until they end.

variants.name: RolledBack
variants.summary: A rollback ended it; it takes no run, and its runs keep their revision.

variants.name: Disabled
variants.summary: Its checks passed; it does not tick.

variants.name: Enabled
variants.summary: It ticks at next_fire_at.

variants.name: Unchecked
variants.summary: Its restriction checks have not passed; it cannot be enabled.
